newsitem.title: USA: NY seeks comment from LCI on sales practices.
newsitem.headline: NY seeks comment from LCI on sales practices.

text.p: The New York State Public Service Commission on Tuesday said it issued show cause orders to long distance providers LCI International Telecom Corp, a unit of LCI International Inc's ; American Business Alliance; and LDM Systems Inc, over alleged "slamming" activities.

Slamming is the practice of switching a consumer's long distance without the individual's permission. The commission said each of the companies has received a high number of slamming complaints from consumers.
The orders require the companies to explain why the Commission should not take further action to prevent future complaints or penalize them for slamming activities.
The three companies will have 30 days from the issuance of the written order to file their response, the commission said.
American Business Alliance and LDM Systems Inc are privately held companies.
